contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; hard direct sun with sharp shadows and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted, and a small damp patch on the paving is not read as rain. Humid is the producer's hot-humid styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The paper bag is a scene prop, not a product. It and the raised arm hide part of the sleeveless shirt front, and that front and the back are conservatively reconstructed. The jeans waist sits under the shirt hem and is inferred. The brown flap bag is seen from behind the arm, so its front is partly inferred. One earring is visible, and the pair is inferred from it. Both slides are visible and listed as one pair. Brand, fibre composition, metal, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: All five overview sheets reviewed. Blue shirt shows no visible stray edge flecks in the final composites.

intro.en: The curved shirt hem comes into view as she shifts a paper bag.

body.ko: 에크루 칼라는 파란 진의 워싱을 밝히고, 갈색 슬라이드와 둥근 플랩백이 같은 온도를 더한다. 금색 링은 목선 위에 작은 빛을 남긴다.
body.en: The ecru collar brightens mid-blue denim. Brown cutout slides echo the rounded flap bag, and gold-tone hoops catch the light above the collar.
body.de: Der Ecrukragen hellt das mittlere Jeansblau auf. Braune Pantoletten greifen die Farbe der runden Klappentasche auf, goldfarbene Creolen fangen über dem Kragen Licht ein.

pull.en: Gold curves above an ecru collar.
